story.titleZh: 确认：劳森因违规被取消排位赛成绩
story.summaryZh: 劳森因违反最小MGU-K动力要求被取消排位赛成绩，尽管车队自行披露违规。
story.originalTitle: Confirmed: Lawson is disqualified from the qualifying results, despite his team self-disclosing the breach The stewards note there are a number of pre...
story.summaryEn:
Confirmed: Lawson is disqualified from the qualifying results, despite his team self-disclosing the breach
The stewards note there are a number of precedents that means a technical infringement has to be disqualification #F1 #MexicoGPChris Medland: Looks like Lawson could lose P9 on the grid for a technical infringement:
Lawson "was in breach of the minimum MGU-K power requirement just after crossing the line on his fastest lap in Q2" according to the technical delegate, so has been referred to the stewards #F1 #MexicoGP
detailZh:
确认：尽管车队自行披露违规行为，劳森仍被取消排位赛成绩
裁判组指出存在多个先例，这意味着技术违规必须取消资格 #F1 #墨西哥大奖赛
Chris Medland：看起来劳森可能因为技术违规而失去第9个发车位：
根据技术代表的说法，劳森在Q2最快圈速过线后违反了最低MGU-K动力要求，因此被提交给裁判组 #F1 #墨西哥大奖赛
detailEn:
Confirmed: Lawson is disqualified from the qualifying results, despite his team self-disclosing the breach
The stewards note there are a number of precedents that means a technical infringement has to be disqualification #F1 #MexicoGPChris Medland: Looks like Lawson could lose P9 on the grid for a technical infringement:
Lawson "was in breach of the minimum MGU-K power requirement just after crossing the line on his fastest lap in Q2" according to the technical delegate, so has been referred to the stewards #F1 #MexicoGP
